system.notes: The Goregons value individual strength and prowess, particularly the shamans who emulate beasts from the wilds. This dynamistic effect ensures a level playing field by instantly stripping an opponent of armor and weapons, leaving them to fight with only their straining muscles and natural abilities. By pointing at a target within range and blowing a puff of herbal smoke in their direction, the shaman causes up to 50 kg of gear to suddenly become immaterial for five minutes — usually time enough for a fight between two individuals to end. The vanished gear lingers as smoke on the victim, reappearing when the smoke finally dissipates.
